headline: 34 contracts catalogued on HyperEVM across kHYPE LST, kmHYPE Markets, vkHYPE Earn vault, and 4 institutional deployments; no on-chain reads possible (HyperEVM not in DeFiPunkd supported chainId list).
short_headline: 34 contracts on HyperEVM; on-chain reads blocked

findings.text: D1: HyperEVMScan search confirmed vkHYPE vault at 0x9BA2EDc44E0A4632EB4723E81d4142353e1bB160 tagged 'Kinetiq Earn Vault (vkHYPE)' and kHYPE token at 0xfD739d4e423301CE9385c1fb8850539D657C296D tagged 'Kinetiq: KHYPE Token'. HyperEVM is not listed in the defipunkd supported chainIds (1,10,56,130,137,324,8453,42161,43114,59144,81457,534352,11155111), so no /api/contract/read or /api/safe/owners calls were possible.

D2: Official deployments doc found at https://kinetiq.xyz/docs/contracts-and-audits. Lists 9 kHYPE LST contracts, 14 kmHYPE Markets contracts, and 12 institutional deployment contracts (Flowdesk, Hyperion, ASXN, HYLQ). vkHYPE Earn vault address NOT listed on this page — sourced separately from website UI (DeBank link) and Veda docs.

D3: 8 audit reports linked from contracts-and-audits page: Spearbit (Jan 2026 — KNTQ, Nov 2025 — kmHYPE, Jun 2025 — kHYPE LST), Zenith (Nov 2025 — kmHYPE, Mar 2025 — kHYPE LST), Pashov Audit Group (Nov 2025 — kHYPE instant unstake, Mar 2025 — kHYPE LST), Code4rena (Apr 2025 — kHYPE LST). Audit PDFs are hosted on Google Drive; direct fetch not attempted (would not yield contract addresses). No audit-era vs current address discrepancies can be assessed without reading PDFs.

D4: GitHub org https://github.com/kinetiq-research has 3 public repos (hl-rs Rust SDK, f1rewall Discord gateway, pendle-balance-fetcher-rs). No smart contract source repos, no deployment artifacts (broadcast JSON, hardhat-deploy, addresses.json) found. Contracts are not open-sourced on GitHub.
D5: Protocol operates exclusively on Hyperliquid L1 / HyperEVM (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required. All discovered addresses are on HyperEVM.

D6: No factory contracts identified in the deployment docs. kmHYPE and institutional deployments appear to be independently deployed instances of the same contract templates, not factory-spawned children. No factory enumeration performed.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: vkHYPE vault (vault/other — Veda-powered), kHYPE token (token), StakingManager (admin), PauserRegistry (guardian), ValidatorManager (admin), StakingAccountant (other), OracleManager (oracle), DefaultOracle (oracle), Operator (other — EOA or multisig unknown). Operator addresses across all deployments marked actor_class=unknown pending on-chain read.

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] traced to fetched URLs: docs page (https://kinetiq.xyz/docs/contracts-and-audits) for kHYPE/kmHYPE/institutional contracts; HyperEVMScan search snippet and Veda docs for vkHYPE vault. No snippet-only sightings without a URL.

rationale.verdict: Walked protocol website, official contracts-and-audits docs page, Earn docs page, security.txt, GitHub org, HyperEVMScan search snippets, and Veda vault deployment docs. Catalogued 34 contracts across kHYPE LST (9), kmHYPE Markets (14), vkHYPE Earn vault (1), and 4 institutional deployments (12 contracts). On-chain reads via defipunkd API were not possible because HyperEVM is not in the supported chainId list; grade set to unknown accordingly.

protocol_metadata.about: Kinetiq is a liquid staking protocol natively built on Hyperliquid's HyperEVM, enabling users to stake HYPE (Hyperliquid's native token) and receive kHYPE, a reward-accruing liquid staking token that can be used across DeFi while underlying HYPE earns validator staking rewards. Kinetiq Earn (this slice) is a yield aggregator vault layer built on top of kHYPE: users deposit kHYPE (or HYPE) into the Veda-powered vkHYPE vault, which automatically deploys capital across curated DeFi strategies on HyperEVM and returns a receipt token (vkHYPE) representing the user's share. The protocol also offers institutional-grade liquid staking (iHYPE/flowHYPE/HiHYPE/asxnHYPE/hylqHYPE), a perpetual futures product (kmHYPE / Markets by Kinetiq), and a KNTQ governance token; validator delegation is managed autonomously by StakeHub.
